# Test fixtures

Small committed files for parser and ingestion tests.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `txt/paragraphs_unicode.txt` | Paragraphs + Unicode |
| `txt/empty.txt` | Empty UTF-8 file |
| `txt/invalid_utf8.txt` | Invalid UTF-8 bytes (decode failure) |
| `markdown/structure.md` | Headings, list, fenced code |
| `markdown/long_article.md` | Longer headed article for chunking experiments |
| `pdf/*.pdf` | Generated by `scripts/generate_pdf_fixtures.py` (PyMuPDF used only to *create* fixtures, not at runtime) |
| `lexical/*.md` | Identifier / rare-term / distractor notes for BM25 and hybrid tests |

PDF binaries are deterministic outputs of that script (PyMuPDF 1.28.2). Tests read the committed files and do not require PyMuPDF.
